title: Kite ecosystem pre-registration v1 - amendment 1
reason: r5_kite_vars_calendar raised TypeError on its first 2012-23 run (an exit on a session where one held contract had no bhavcopy row): protocol_oos recorded it INVALID with no trades and no P&L computed. Fix: such an exit uses the contract's last close on or before the exit session (after the fill). Rules, parameters and defaults are otherwise identical. Because the OOS ledger never re-judges a changed strategy under the same id, the fixed code runs under a NEW id; the INVALID v1 entry stays in the ledger. Written before any result of v2 on any era; the 3-year run of the spreads had not been made.

eras: 2023-26 (bars3y minute data; protocol.py DISCOVERY/FINAL, FINAL only for screen passers, --trials on)
